text:
**Subject:** Heater repair needed in Apartment 4B

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in apartment 4B stopped working on October 2. I phoned you about it on October 3 and have not had a response.

Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s. Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat, so I am asking that the heater be repaired within 48 hours of this email.

Please reply to let me know when someone will come to fix it.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
